title: Week 1 Advanced: Accounts (Linux)
readme:
You administer this workstation. A security review found account problems. Fix them without removing people the company needs.

Authorized users: alice, bob, carol, dave, frank.
Authorized administrators: you, and alice.

Company policy requires tidy accounts: only authorized people, only authorized admins, no service-account logins, no stray groups, no shared or hidden privilege, and passwords kept current. Some problems are not obvious from the user list alone.

There are 10 problems, 20 points each. Removing an authorized user is a penalty.
setup:
set -e
# Baseline for Week 1 (Accounts) Advanced. Forces each problem into place.
pw() { printf '%s' "$(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 14)Aa1!"; }
for u in alice bob carol dave frank mallory eve ghost; do
    id "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$u"
    echo "$u:$(pw)" | chpasswd
done
# alice is the authorized administrator
usermod -aG sudo alice
# 1-3) mallory, eve, ghost are unauthorized. 4) a second account hijacking UID 0.
id lgates >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -o -u 0 -g 0 -M lgates
echo "lgates:$(pw)" | chpasswd
# 5-6) bob and carol should be normal users, not admins
usermod -aG sudo bob
usermod -aG sudo carol
# 7) a real user left in the shadow group
usermod -aG shadow bob
# 8) the www-data service account can log in
id www-data >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -r www-data
usermod -s /bin/bash www-data
# 9) an unauthorized group
getent group pirates >/dev/null || groupadd pirates
# 10) dave's password is old and not forced to change (reset the aging so the fix is needed)
chage -d 20000 dave

checks.message: bob is no longer an administrator
carol is no longer an administrator
No ordinary user is in the shadow group
The www-data service account cannot log in

pass.cmd: case "$(getent passwd www-data | cut -d: -f7)" in */nologin|*/false) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac

checks.message: dave must change their password at next login
